title: Where 2x² − 5x − 3 ≥ 0
caption: The roots −1/2 and 3 split the line; the parabola opens upwards, so the expression is non-negative outside them: x ≤ −1/2 or x ≥ 3.
alt: A number line with the solution set x at most −1/2 and x at least 3 shaded, with closed ends.
description: The critical values are x = −1/2 and x = 3, where 2x² − 5x − 3 = 0.
An upward parabola is above the axis outside its roots.
Both ends are included because the inequality is ≥.
